title: Free Printable Bingo, Word Searches and Party Games
metaDescription: Make free printable bingo cards, word searches, scavenger hunts, word scrambles and kids' charts in your browser. No sign-up, Letter or A4, PDF or print.
h1: Free Printable Bingo Cards, Word Searches & Party Games
subhead: Make it, print it, play it in seconds. No sign-up.
intro: Pick a tool, start from one of our ready-made theme lists or paste your own words, and print as many sheets as your group needs. Everything runs right in your browser, so it is quick on a phone, a laptop or a school Chromebook.

tools.blurb: Word bingo, 75-ball, 90-ball UK tickets and 1 to 30 number cards, with a caller sheet. Up to 30 unique cards at a time.
Grids from 10 x 10 to 20 x 20 in three difficulty levels, with an optional answer key.
Checklists, photo hunts and team score sheets, shuffled per copy so teams don't trail each other.
Unscramble puzzles with optional first-letter hints, a word bank and an answer key.
Picture charts for bath, teeth, pajamas and story time, with your child's name at the top.
Sticker and tick-box charts for chores, reading, potty training and good days.
Call numbers or words on screen, with a called board, undo, auto-call and an optional voice.

why.heading: Why frogsdream
body:
* **It's free to use.** Every tool on this site is free, and so is printing the results for home, classroom and party use.
* **No sign-up.** There is no account to create and no email to hand over. Open a page and start.
* **Works on phones and Chromebooks.** The tools run in any modern browser, so you can set up a game on your phone and print it from the school computer.
* **Letter and A4.** Switch the paper size with one tap, and the sheets resize to fit.
* **Friendly to your printer.** Ink saver mode prints clean black-and-white sheets that copy well.
* **Share the exact set.** A share link brings back the same words and the same cards, which helps when a co-teacher or co-host needs a copy.
frogsdream is a small independent project. If something doesn't print right or a word list has a mistake, [let us know](/contact/) and we will fix it.
